title: Death Declaration Upgraded
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji hadn't yet come back to his senses from the prophecy, a gentle knock came from outside the door. A familiar bloodline aura pierced through the numerous restrictions and clearly reached his perception—it was Chen Nian. She had come, bringing those eyes that could see through his disguises since childhood.

text.content: Blood-colored text slowly spread across the seventh page of the Tianji Record, like an invisible brush writing the verdict of destiny. Chen Ji stared at those gradually forming characters, his knuckles turning white. "The Seventh Prophet"—this title should have been an honor, yet now it burned his eyes like a branding iron. Master Mo had said the Tianji Record never speaks without purpose; every word it writes will become reality at some point in the future.

The characters grew clearer with each stroke, each one carving flesh from his heart. "Chapter 700, Chen Ji will die from destiny's backlash." He recited those blood words silently, yet a self-mocking curve twisted his lips—he had calculated countless people's fates, yet couldn't predict his own death date. Ironic, utterly ironic. The Tianji Record seemed to mock his arrogance: You thought yourself the chess player, but you are merely another piece.

The blood text paused for several breaths after "Unless", as if the eye of heaven was deliberately creating this suffocating suspense. Chen Ji stared fixedly at that blank space, a弦 in his chest stretched to the limit. Finally, new characters began to appear—"Unless the Heavenly Fate Lock Key is fully unlocked before Chapter 700." His pupils contracted sharply. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key... that was Chen Nian.

Unlocking the Heavenly Fate Lock Key—these six words like a blunt knife, sawing back and forth across his heart. He knew better than anyone what this meant. When the Holy Sect took Chen Nian away back then, it wasn't to kill her, but to utilize the dormant Heavenly Fate power within her. To unlock the key, Chen Nian must voluntarily awaken that power, and once awakened, she would become a target for all—Demonic Path, Righteous Path, everyone coveting Heavenly Fate would pounce upon her.

dialogue.content: I searched for her for ten years...

text.content: Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice hoarse, unlike himself. Ten years. He had plotted across the world, calculated all living beings, everything he did seemingly to change his fate, but in truth merely to find his sister and have enough strength to protect her. Now destiny told him: to save her, he must push her into the fire pit. He slowly closed his eyes, and that thin, frail figure appeared in his mind—the moment they parted, young Chen Nian grabbing his clothes and crying "Brother", and he swore he would return for her.

The seventh page of the Tianji Record rippled again, new text appearing: "Unlock Conditions: Blood Resonance, Hearts Aligned, Fates Shared." Chen Ji stared at this line,苦涩的笑声 escaped him. Blood resonance required him and Chen Nian to face each other directly; hearts aligned meant he must tell her all the truth; and fates shared—that Chen Nian would be bound to him, jointly bearing the Tianji Record's backlash. She could have stayed out of this, but now she would be dragged into this murky water by him.

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record never gives an unsolvable死局; while it deprives, it also gives hope. But this hope... is often harder to bear than despair.

text.content: Master Mo's remnant soul floated out from the first page, his aged face carrying an indescribable complexity. Chen Ji looked up at that wisp of ghost, his eyes burning with unprecedented fury: "You knew all along, didn't you? Knew the consequences of me obtaining the complete Tianji Record, knew the unlock conditions—you knew everything, yet said nothing!" His voice suddenly rose; this was the first time he had raged at Master Mo. Ten years of scheming, he was accustomed to bearing the backlash of his calculations alone, but this time involving Chen Nian, he couldn't stay calm.

dialogue.content: I told you, and you wouldn't have fought for this seventh page. The Tianji Record's completeness requires a price, and that price... should be borne by me. I was the one who pushed you into this chess game; this old man owes you the truth.

text.content: Chen Ji froze. He looked at this remnant soul that could dissipate at any moment, suddenly remembering Master Mo's expression each time he seemed about to speak yet held back, the anomalies he had deliberately ignored. So that was it—not that he wouldn't tell him, but if told, he wouldn't have reached this point. The Tianji Record's completeness required the執念者's fate to bear it, and from the very beginning, Master Mo had been using his remnant soul to buy him time.

choice.prompt: Faced with this sudden truth and destiny's certain death, Chen Ji must make a choice—

choices.text: Face the truth, find Chen Nian
choices.description: No matter how dangerous the road ahead, he must tell his sister everything in person. Ten years of separation was enough; he didn't want her kept in the dark any longer. Even if pushing her into the fire pit, he would hold her hand and face it together.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his true strength and schemes may attract enemy pursuit
choices.visible_reward: Gaining Chen Nian's trust and cooperation greatly increases the possibility of unlocking the Heavenly Fate Lock Key
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may not be able to withstand the truth and collapse, and may be detected by other forces

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucking the Tianji Record into his chest. Ten years. He had grown accustomed to walking alone in the darkness, swallowing all dangers alone. But Chen Nian was his sister, his only blood relative in this world. He couldn't let her be swept into the vortex without her knowledge—this was the last thing a brother should do.

choices.text: Endure and lie low, plan alone
choices.description: Chen Nian shouldn't bear any of this for him. He decided to continue hiding everything and seek other ways to break the局 alone. Even if it meant death, he should die alone and never implicate his sister. This was the last thing he could do for her.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the timing to break the局 and fall into greater passivity
choices.visible_reward: Buy time to seek other solutions, avoiding Chen Nian's premature exposure
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record's backlash may intensify at any moment, other forces may find Chen Nian first

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes gradually regained their composure. He was the Tianji Record's 執念者, the man who had laid a great scheme for ten years—how could he let all his planning go to waste due to momentary impulse? Chen Nian was still alive; as long as she lived, there was hope. He couldn't take risks; he must find a more stable method—even if it meant continuing to play the role of that useless废物.

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record's price is the 執念者's fate, if he actively burns away his Heavenly Fate Value before Chapter 700, can he take the backlash with him? Let Chen Nian never know the truth, let her live safely forever—this was the last tenderness he could give her.
choices.visible_cost: May sacrifice in vain, unable to confirm whether it can truly remove the backlash
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the risk of Chen Nian being implicated, allowing her to return to a normal life
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may simply change to another 執念者, and Chen Nian will still be targeted by other forces

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a hint of resolution. He had schemed against too many people in this life, owed too many people, yet had never owed Chen Nian. Failing to protect her back then was his fault; now if he could repay that debt with his life, it would be perfect. Just... he was still somewhat unwilling.

Just as he sank into the mud of decision, a familiar bloodline aura suddenly pierced through the numerous restrictions, like a drop of water falling into a lake, creating rippling waves in his perception. Chen Ji's body went rigid—Chen Nian's aura, pure, warm, yet carrying a disturbance that made his heart tremble. She was nearby, and... she had sensed something.

Blood Resonance—this was the precursor to the Heavenly Fate Lock Key's awakening. Chen Ji instantly understood what was happening: when the Tianji Record manifested the prophecy just now, the leaked Heavenly Fate power was too abundant, creating a resonance with the Lock Key within Chen Nian. She had sensed his presence, sensed that unbreakable bond in their blood. And now, that aura was rapidly approaching.

Knock, knock, knock—the gentle knocking in the silent night rang like thunder in Chen Ji's heart. Outside the door came a soft yet firm female voice: "Brother, I know you're in there. I sensed... sensed that you're in danger." Chen Ji shuddered all over. That voice—Chen Nian, the voice he had dreamed of for ten years, now just beyond the咫尺.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian had found him; blood resonance rendered all hiding meaningless. He must decide how to face her—

choices.description: Ten years of pretending was enough; he didn't want to perform anymore before his sister. Open the door, tell her everything—the Tianji Record, the prophecy, the Lock Key, and his impending death. Before life and death, blood is the only truth.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose all his disguises and schemes
choices.visible_reward: Be completely honest with Chen Nian and gain her full support
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may be unable to accept the truth and lose emotional control, drawing attention

dialogue.content: The door slowly opened, moonlight pouring in. Chen Nian stood outside, those clear eyes brimming with tears, yet stubbornly refusing to let them fall. Ten years apart, she had grown from the little girl back then into a graceful young woman, but the purity and stubbornness in those eyes remained exactly as before. "Brother... I searched for you for ten years."

choices.text: Speak through the door, test her intentions
choices.description: How did she find this place? Pure blood resonance, or was someone guiding her? He needed to first understand all this before deciding whether to let her wade into this murky water. Opening the door rashly was too dangerous.
choices.visible_cost: May hurt Chen Nian's feelings and deepen her doubts
choices.visible_reward: Confirm whether the surroundings are safe, eliminate the risk of being used by others
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may develop alienation toward him because of this, missing the best timing

dialogue.content: The door didn't open; Chen Nian's voice came through the door planks, carrying a hint of hurt: "Brother, you won't open the door, is there something inside you can't let me see?" Chen Ji's hand hovered over the door latch, caught between advancing and retreating. Ten years. He thought he had long tempered his heart into steel, but facing this sister, all disguises were crumbling.

text.content: Outside the door, silence held for a moment, then Chen Nian's light laughter drifted in, that laughter carrying ten years of漂泊's desolation and relief: "Brother, I sensed the aura of the Tianji Record, and also... the smell of death." Chen Ji's heart tightened sharply. "There's a lock inside me, and a key inside your book. The Holy Sect people have always wanted us to meet, to open that lock." Her voice was terrifyingly calm. "But they don't know—I've been waiting for this day too. The day I can stand beside you."

Chen Ji's hand trembled. He thought he was the one plotting across the world, thought everything was under his control, yet didn't know the most crucial piece had walked onto the board itself long ago. Chen Nian knew, knew from the very beginning. She wasn't a sacrifice carried along by destiny, but a fellow traveler who actively chose to descend into the abyss with him. "So," the voice outside the door spoke again, gentle yet firm, "Brother, open the door. Whatever you have to say, whatever lies ahead... I want to face it together with you."

Under the moonlight, the door slowly opened. Chen Nian stood outside, her clear eyes reflecting her brother's figure, tears still on her cheeks yet her smile bright. Chen Ji looked at that face, so reminiscent of memory, and suddenly felt the boulder that had pressed on his heart for ten years loosen somewhat. Ten years of scheming, ten years of endurance, ten years of walking alone on the blade's edge—turned out he was never fighting alone. The bond of blood was never broken; it simply pushed them toward each other in another way.
